meta.name: positioning-workshop
meta.description: Run a positioning workshop that surfaces target customer, unmet need, category, benefits, and differentiation. Use when your product messaging feels fuzzy, generic, or misaligned.

copy.tagline: 梳理产品定位，明确目标客户与差异化优势
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果产品信息模糊、缺乏差异化，需要清晰定位
copy.tagline_en: Clarify product positioning, target customers, and differentiation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your product messaging feels fuzzy and needs clear positioning

howto.what: 引导你完成5个步骤的定位工作坊：明确目标客户、未满足需求、产品类别、核心收益和差异化优势，最终生成一份Geoffrey Moore定位声明。
howto.when: 当你的产品信息模糊、泛泛或错位时，例如在撰写PRD、发布计划或营销材料之前，需要对齐战略定位。

say.text: 帮我的B2B分析产品跑一次定位工作坊。
say.note: Claude会逐步提问，收集信息后生成定位声明。

say.text: 我们的信息太泛了，引导一次定位会议。
say.note: Claude会从目标客户开始，逐一询问5个问题。

howto.what_en: Guides you through a 5-step positioning workshop: identify target customer, unmet need, product category, key benefit, and differentiation, then outputs a Geoffrey Moore positioning statement.
howto.when_en: Use when your product messaging feels fuzzy, generic, or misaligned, e.g., before writing PRDs, launch plans, or marketing materials to align strategic positioning.

say_en.text: Run a positioning workshop for our B2B analytics product.
say_en.note: Claude will ask adaptive questions and generate a statement.

say_en.text: Our messaging feels generic. Facilitate a positioning session.
say_en.note: Claude starts with target customer and proceeds step by step.
